about:
# Steward Badges for Daylight

Show shared K/V/A/B decisions on Daylight bag slots.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- One compact letter per carried stack: Keep, Vendor, Auction or Bank.
- Uses the same evaluator as Bag Steward and Mail Steward.
- Keeps independent gear-upgrade indicators and other bag-corner marks.

## Requirements

DaylightUI_Bags, ItemTree, BagSteward

## Controls

Bag Steward settings control the evaluator and marks.

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `DaylightItemTreeKVA` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.2.0`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/StewardBadges/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
